_comment: Copy to config.json and add your testnet keys. config.json is gitignored.
_keys: Free testnet keys: https://testnet.binance.vision — sign in with GitHub, then 'Generate HMAC_SHA256 Key'. These are NOT your real Binance keys and control no real funds.
_sizing: paperEquity drives position size, NOT the testnet balance. Set it to the amount you actually intend to trade so the results transfer.
_strategy: The only configuration that survived out-of-sample testing. See README.
_exits: takeProfitPct null = use targetRMultiple instead. Backtest says a fixed +10% halves expectancy; +15% is roughly neutral.
